name: NGGB
recent: Nextgreen Global Berhad 近期多次因 ESOS 行使而发行新股，最新一次于 2026 年 11 月 26 日上市 99 万股。董事及主要股东在 9 月有增持记录，并在 10 月闭市期前申报交易意向。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比增长 50.5%，净利润环比增长 31.9%。
notable: 公司因 ESOS 行使而多次发行新股，最新一批 99 万股于 2026 年 11 月 26 日上市。
董事 Dato' Lim Thiam Huat 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日以每股 RM0.70 增持 88.5 万股。
主要股东 Dato' Gan Kong Hiok 于 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间有多份股权变动申报。
risks: 董事及主要股东在 2026 年 10 月闭市期前申报有意交易公司股票。
ESOS 行使持续小幅稀释现有股东持股比例。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 26.774 百万，环比增长 50.5%，同比增长 29.1%；净利润为 MYR 10.495 百万，环比增长 31.9%，同比增长 3.8%；净利率为 39.2%，低于上一季度的 44.7%。

recent_en: Nextgreen Global Berhad has issued new shares multiple times recently due to ESOS exercises, with the latest 990,000 shares listed on 26 Nov 2026. Directors and substantial shareholders recorded acquisitions in September and declared intention to trade ahead of the closed period in October. The latest quarter ended 30 June 2026 saw revenue rise 50.5% QoQ and net income rise 31.9% QoQ.
notable_en: The company issued new shares multiple times due to ESOS exercises, with the latest 990,000 shares listed on 26 Nov 2026.
Director Dato' Lim Thiam Huat acquired 885,000 shares at RM0.70 per share on 1 Sep 2026.
Substantial shareholder Dato' Gan Kong Hiok filed multiple changes in shareholding between September and November 2026.
risks_en: Directors and a substantial shareholder declared intention to trade the company's shares ahead of the closed period in October 2026.
Continued ESOS exercises modestly dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 26.774 million, up 50.5% QoQ and 29.1% YoY; net income was MYR 10.495 million, up 31.9% QoQ and 3.8% YoY; net margin was 39.2%, down from 44.7% in the previous quarter.
